finance-tax-calculator v1.0.0

- Initial release of the finance-tax-calculator skill for listed company tax calculations.
- Covers VAT (general/small-scale), corporate income tax (quarterly/year-end), individual income tax (cumulative method/comprehensive), surtaxes, tax filing logic, and burden warnings.
- Provides calculation formulas, industry benchmarks, policy highlights, sample cases, and compliance checkpoints.
- Includes tax triggers for VAT, CIT, IIT, surtaxes, and tax filing scenarios.
